title: The deal that trapped John Marston in Red Dead Redemption
subject: marston
description:
Would you have taken Ross's deal? 👇

Why John Marston hunted his own gang in 1911, and Dutch's final words to him. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption.

scenes.text: Two federal agents took John Marston's wife and son in 1911.
Edgar Ross and Archer Fordham of the Bureau wanted one thing: his old gang.
First Bill Williamson at Fort Mercer, then Javier Escuella across the border in Mexico.
Javier was the man who once carried a wounded John back to camp.
Last on the list was Dutch, holed up in the mountain camp at Cochinay.
Cornered at a cliff edge, Dutch told him, "Our time has passed, John." Then he stepped off.
Ross used John to erase the gang. Now John was the last one left.
